t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Keep an eye on the colours of each gnome and the shape of the cones to get more points.

vb_textbox.text: first experiment which colour gnomes and which shape gnomes will give you points. I found that the flat gnomes will give more points in the first round and then second round the cone gnomes give more points taking in turns. I found some colours will offer more points than other colours.
